# filename: compute_em_fund_increase.py

# python
import pandas as pd

data = [
    {"Fund Name":"Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund","Ticker":"FEMKX","NAV May 2019":33.50,"NAV May 2024":36.00,"Transaction Fee":"$0"},
    {"Fund Name":"Fidelity Total Emerging Markets Fund","Ticker":"FTEMX","NAV May 2019":14.20,"NAV May 2024":15.10,"Transaction Fee":"$0"},
    {"Fund Name":"Fidelity Emerging Asia Fund","Ticker":"FEASX","NAV May 2019":28.40,"NAV May 2024":29.50,"Transaction Fee":"$0"}
]

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df["% Increase"] = (df["NAV May 2024"] - df["NAV May 2019"]) / df["NAV May 2019"] * 100

print("Computed percentage increases (May 2019 to May 2024):")
print(df[["Fund Name","Ticker","NAV May 2019","NAV May 2024","% Increase","Transaction Fee"]])

min_row = df.loc[df["% Increase"].idxmin()]
print("\nFund with lowest percentage increase:")
print({"Fund Name":min_row["Fund Name"],"Ticker":min_row["Ticker"],"% Increase":round(min_row["% Increase"],2)})
